description: Shut the shutter, set the bran, and kept him.
name: Anne Shakespeare

description: Kept the frame from coming down, and sent the ale to the other men.
name: Hamnet Sadler

description: Called the hold from the ladder, then saw the face.
name: John Shakespeare

description: Lifted from the legs, then kept him on his feet and turned him toward home.
name: Richard Shakespeare

description: Spoke it to the dark over the hall, and ended.
name: William Shakespeare
